result.instructions: Tools for Gavel, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my Gavel workflows."; "Which variables does my NDA workflow need?"; "Create a session of the NDA workflow with the client name Acme Ltd.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Gavel data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gavel_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gavel_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gavel_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. gavel_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gavel_list_workflows
tools.title: List workflows
tools.description: List the names of all Gavel workflows on the account. API: GET /api/playground?folder=questions.

tools.name: gavel_get_workflow_variables
tools.title: Get workflow variables
tools.description: Get the variable schema of one workflow: each variable name, data type, input type, label, options and whether it is required. Use it to learn what data gavel_create_session accepts. API: GET /officeaddin?pgtypes=<name>.yml.

workflow_name.description: The workflow name, case-sensitive, as gavel_list_workflows returns it (with or without ".yml").

tools.name: gavel_create_session
tools.title: Create a workflow session
tools.description: WRITE: create a new session of a workflow with pre-filled variables. It does not send or sign anything. Each call creates one more session. Returns session_id and a continuation_url. If all variables are given, the URL opens the document download page; else the user answers only the missing questions. Dates: '2024-05-30T'. Date time: ISO 8601. Multi select: array of option labels. Repeating items: array of objects. Use gavel_get_workflow_variables for the names. API: POST /api/documate/v1/interviews/{name}/new.

workflow_name.description: The workflow name, case-sensitive, as gavel_list_workflows returns it (with or without ".yml").

variables.description: Variable name to value. Text or number: plain value. Repeating item: array of objects.

tools.name: gavel_list_session_documents
tools.title: List session documents
tools.description: List the documents of a completed workflow session: name, format (docx or pdf), type, source template and download URL. This tool returns metadata only. The download URL needs the X-Api-Key header. API: GET /api/documate/v1/data-manager/workflows/{name}/session/{id}/documents.

workflow_name.description: The workflow name, case-sensitive, as gavel_list_workflows returns it (with or without ".yml").
